def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a NumPy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(tau_filter)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    # Check shape match
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All arrays must have the same shape")
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t_offsets = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t_offsets)
    sum_weights = raw_weights.sum()
    if sum_weights == 0:
        raise ValueError("Future horizon leads to zero total weight")
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / sum_weights
    # Compute weighted losses (negative weighted log prob)
    loss_with = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_empty = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Counterfactual baseline: min of empty and call-only
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_empty, loss_call)
    margin = loss_minus - loss_with
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin
